entities.summary: Rafael Leónidas Felipe y Núñez was a Dominican Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Barahona from 1999 to 2015. Felipe y Núñez died on 10 December 2025, at the age of 87.

entities.summary: Rafael Leónidas Felipe y Núñez was a Dominican Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Barahona from 1999 to 2015. Felipe y Núñez died on 10 December 2025, at the age of 87.
